title: Colonial Gas Company files for approval by the Department of Telecommunications a 365 Day Firm Transportation Agreement with Lowell Cogeneration Limited Partnership.
petitioner: Colonial Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: Attorney General's data and information requests. By: John M. Grugan, Assistant Attorney General. (GC 00-08)

The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr. (GC 00-08)
